**First beta!** 🎉 Thanks to everyone who tested the alphas.

## New in this release
- **App icon:** a little timetable grid.
- **License:** BetterBetterUntis is now licensed under the **GNU GPL v3** (it was MIT up to 0.3.2).
- The Debug screen (raw API data) is only included in alpha builds now.

## What's in the app
- Week and full-screen day view; offline cache; substitutions, cancellations and exams at a glance
- Teachers shown even when your school hides them; teacher and room timetables rebuilt from class timetables
- Colours per state and per subject, fill or border per state, text size, bold and centred text
- Multiple accounts and schools; parent accounts with child switching and absence reporting
- Info center: messages, inbox, homework, exams, absences, office hours
- Export as CSV, XLSX or PDF
- Self-hostable web version

## Known issues
- Parent accounts that log in through **ID Austria** don't work yet.

## Install
**Android:** download the `.apk` and open it. It updates the alphas in place.

**iPhone / iPad:** sideload the unsigned `.ipa` with [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) or [AltStore](https://altstore.io).

**Web:** unpack `…-web-linux-x64.tar.gz` and run `./bbu_server`, or use the Dockerfile from the repo (see `WEB.md`).
